disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia spectrum disorder clinical cohorts (SSD-V and SSD-NV).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "persons with a history of severe violence and comorbid schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD-V, n = 38; i.e. schizophrenia n = 35, schizoaffective disorder n = 1, schizophreniform disorder n = 1, other psychosis n = 1), ... persons with no history of violence but with a schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD-NV n = 138; i.e. schizophrenia n = 87, schizoaffective disorder n = 17, schizophreniform disorder n = 7, other psychosis n = 27)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Participants were recruited from four Oslo-area studies; mapping of SSD-V/SSD-NV to specific studies not specified.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Participants ... were recruited from the Oslo area as part of four studies: the Thematically Organized Psychosis study (TOP) [30], the STROKEMRI study [31], The Youth-TOP study (uTOP) [32], and The Forensic Psychiatry study (sTOP) [33]."

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD across SSD-V (n=38) and SSD-NV (n=138); min/max taken from reported group ranges.

sex.detail: All participants in the clinical groups were male; SSD-V (n=38) + SSD-NV (n=138).
sex.supporting_text: "All individuals were male due to the scarcity of eligible women within the participating forensic psychiatry units and prisons."
